title: HSK 3.5 · 经历, 经验, 报告, 设计, 艺术
focus: 按 · 线 · 报告 · 台 · 伤 · 曾经 · 另外 · 简单 · 血 · 到底 · 派 · 好好 · 技术 · 设计 · 利用 · 性 · 建议 · 报道 · 报 · 经历 · 困难 · 难道 · 照 · 达到 · 美丽 · 经验 · 直到 · 完美 · 经济 · 按照 · 直 · 胜利 · 受伤 · 艺术 · 美好 · 设备 · 表达 · 胜 · 意外 · 表明
body:
经 (pass through) runs through four words here, 报 (report) through three, and 美 (beautiful) through three more. Several pairs differ by one character: 经历 / 经验, 技术 / 艺术, 设计 / 设备.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 经 | jīng | pass through; manage (纟 silk) | 曾经, 经历, 经验, 经济 |
| 报 | bào | report; newspaper | 报告, 报道, 报 |
| 美 | měi | beautiful | 美丽, 完美, 美好 |
| 到 | dào | arrive, reach | 到底, 达到, 直到 |
| 表 | biǎo | show | 表达, 表明 |
| 设 | shè | set up (讠 + 殳) | 设计, 设备 |
| 术 | shù | skill, method | 技术, 艺术 |
| 直 | zhí | straight | 直到, 直 |

## Watch out

- 经历 = events you went through; 经验 = know-how you gained from them.
- 血 is xuè in writing (血型) and usually xiě in speech (流血了).
- 难道 starts a rhetorical question: 难道你不知道？ "Don't tell me you didn't know?"

cards.Example: 按这个按钮。 àn zhège ànniǔ: press this button
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + 安 ān for the sound = press down with the hand. Also "according to" (按时 on time).

cards.Example: 这条线很长。 zhè tiáo xiàn hěn cháng: this line is long
cards.Notes: 纟 silk + 戋 (sound part) = thread → line. 在线 online, 路线 route.

cards.Example: 我在写报告。 wǒ zài xiě bàogào: I'm writing a report
cards.Notes: 报 report + 告 tell = report.

cards.Example: 他在台上唱歌。 tā zài tái shang chàng gē: he's singing on stage
cards.Notes: 厶 over 口. In 台湾, 电视台 TV station; the sound part in 抬 tái, 始 shǐ.

cards.Example: 你的伤好了吗？ nǐ de shāng hǎo le ma: has your wound healed?
cards.Notes: 亻 person + a simplified sound part (from 昜 yáng) = injury. 伤心 sad, 受伤 hurt.

cards.Example: 我曾经去过北京。 wǒ céngjīng qù guo Běijīng: I've been to Beijing before
cards.Notes: 曾 céng once (Zēng as a surname) + 经 pass through = once been through → formerly.

cards.Example: 另外一个呢？ lìngwài yí ge ne: and what about the other one?
cards.Notes: 另 separate, other (口 + 力) + 外 outside = another, besides.

cards.Example: 这很简单。 zhè hěn jiǎndān: that's simple
cards.Notes: 简 simple, bamboo slip (⺮ + 间 jiān for the sound) + 单 single = simple.

cards.Example: 你流血了！ nǐ liú xiě le: you're bleeding!
cards.Notes: 皿 dish + a stroke on top (a drop) = blood in a sacrificial dish. Lookalike: 皿 mǐn dish.

cards.Example: 你到底去不去？ nǐ dàodǐ qù bu qù: are you going or not?
cards.Notes: 到 reach + 底 bottom = reach the bottom → in the end. In questions: "on earth".

cards.Example: 公司派我去上海。 gōngsī pài wǒ qù Shànghǎi: the company is sending me to Shanghai
cards.Notes: 氵 water + a river splitting into branches = branch of a river → faction; to send out.

cards.Example: 好好休息。 hǎohǎo xiūxi: get a good rest
cards.Notes: 好 good, doubled = really well, properly. Often said hǎohāor.

cards.Example: 他的技术很好。 tā de jìshù hěn hǎo: he's very skilled
cards.Notes: 技 skill (扌 hand + 支 zhī for the sound) + 术 method = technique, technology.

cards.Example: 这个设计很好看。 zhège shèjì hěn hǎokàn: this design looks great
cards.Notes: 设 set up + 计 plan, count (讠 + 十) = set up a plan → design.

cards.Meaning: to make use of; to exploit
cards.Example: 要好好利用时间。 yào hǎohǎo lìyòng shíjiān: make good use of your time
cards.Notes: 利 benefit, sharp (禾 grain + 刂 knife) + 用 use = use to your advantage.

cards.Example: 他的性格很好。 tā de xìnggé hěn hǎo: he has a nice personality
cards.Notes: 忄 heart + 生 shēng (born; sound) = inborn nature. As a suffix -ness: 重要性 importance.

cards.Example: 我有个建议。 wǒ yǒu ge jiànyì: I have a suggestion
cards.Notes: 建 build, put forward + 议 discuss (讠 speech + 义) = put forward for discussion → suggest.

cards.Example: 我看了这个报道。 wǒ kàn le zhège bàodào: I saw this report
cards.Notes: 报 report + 道 say = report the news.

cards.Example: 爸爸每天看报。 bàba měitiān kàn bào: Dad reads the paper every day
cards.Notes: 扌 hand + a right-hand part. Words: 报纸 newspaper, 报名 sign up, 报告 report.

cards.Example: 他经历了很多。 tā jīnglì le hěn duō: he's been through a lot
cards.Notes: 经 pass through + 历 go through, past (厂 + 力) = what you've lived through.

cards.Example: 有困难找我。 yǒu kùnnan zhǎo wǒ: come to me if you have trouble
cards.Notes: 困 trapped (木 tree in a 囗 box) + 难 hard = stuck and hard → difficulty.

cards.Example: 难道你不知道？ nándào nǐ bù zhīdào: you mean you didn't know?
cards.Notes: 难 hard + 道 say = hard to say → "can it really be that…?" Starts a rhetorical question.

cards.Meaning: to shine; to take (a photo); according to
cards.Example: 我来照张相。 wǒ lái zhào zhāng xiàng: let me take a photo
cards.Notes: 昭 zhāo bright (sound) + 灬 fire = light shining → shine, photograph. 按照 according to.

cards.Example: 我们达到了目标。 wǒmen dádào le mùbiāo: we reached our goal
cards.Notes: 达 reach (辶 walk + 大) + 到 arrive = reach a level or goal.

cards.Example: 她很美丽。 tā hěn měilì: she's beautiful
cards.Notes: 美 beautiful + 丽 lovely = beautiful. More written than 漂亮.

cards.Example: 他很有经验。 tā hěn yǒu jīngyàn: he's very experienced
cards.Notes: 经 pass through + 验 test (马 + 佥 for the sound) = tested by going through → know-how.

cards.Example: 直到现在我才明白。 zhídào xiànzài wǒ cái míngbai: only now do I understand
cards.Notes: 直 straight + 到 arrive = straight up to → until.

cards.Example: 太完美了！ tài wánměi le: that's perfect!
cards.Notes: 完 complete + 美 beautiful = completely beautiful → perfect.

cards.Example: 经济发展很快。 jīngjì fāzhǎn hěn kuài: the economy is growing fast
cards.Notes: 经 manage + 济 help (氵 + 齐 qí for the sound); from 经世济民 "run the world, help the people".

cards.Example: 按照规定办。 ànzhào guīdìng bàn: do it by the rules
cards.Notes: 按 by, press + 照 follow, as = according to.

cards.Example: 一直走。 yìzhí zǒu: go straight ahead
cards.Notes: 十 + 目 eye + a line below = an eye looking straight → straight. 一直 always, straight.

cards.Example: 我们胜利了！ wǒmen shènglì le: we won!
cards.Notes: 胜 win + 利 advantage = victory.

cards.Example: 他受伤了。 tā shòushāng le: he got hurt
cards.Notes: 受 receive, suffer + 伤 wound = get injured.

cards.Example: 我喜欢艺术。 wǒ xǐhuan yìshù: I like art
cards.Notes: 艺 skill, art (艹 + 乙) + 术 technique = art. Compare 技术 technology.

cards.Example: 美好的明天。 měihǎo de míngtiān: a bright tomorrow
cards.Notes: 美 beautiful + 好 good = fine. Used for abstract things: life, future, memories.

cards.Example: 这些设备很新。 zhèxiē shèbèi hěn xīn: this equipment is new
cards.Notes: 设 set up + 备 prepare = things set up and ready → equipment.

cards.Example: 我不会表达。 wǒ bú huì biǎodá: I'm bad at expressing myself
cards.Notes: 表 show + 达 reach, convey = convey outward → express.

cards.Example: 我们队胜了。 wǒmen duì shèng le: our team won
cards.Notes: 月 (body) + 生 shēng for the sound = win, surpass. Opposite: 败 bài lose.

cards.Example: 真是个意外！ zhēn shì ge yìwài: what a surprise!
cards.Notes: 意 expectation + 外 outside = outside expectations → unexpected; an accident.

cards.Example: 这表明他很忙。 zhè biǎomíng tā hěn máng: this shows he's busy
cards.Notes: 表 show + 明 clear = show clearly.
